integrity: Proof from Walsh weight-four geometry, Fano uniqueness, Hamming-code incidence, and independent-lift bijection; executable exact-integer checks supplement rather than replace infinite-family proof.
scientific_limitations: Classifies exactly the specified one-vertex-affine-simplex pair in binary vector spaces; does not classify all eight-point pairs or weighted Fourier systems. Independent audit and exhaustive historical novelty certification are not performed.
title: A Fano-plane compatibility law for simultaneous eight-point Walsh spectra
